title: Jupiter's gravity helps power volcanoes on Io
body: Voyager 1 spotted volcanic activity on Io in 1979. As Io moves around Jupiter in a slightly stretched orbit, changing tidal forces repeatedly flex the moon, warming its interior.
takeaway: A moon can stay geologically active using heat generated by its orbital motion.
source: NASA Science, Io Facts and Galileo Science
visual: an erupting volcano on Jupiter's moon Io viewed against black space
